title: Per-tenant Warmup & Smoothing API scratchbook
content:
Context / quick motivation:
- Observed noisy cold-start costs and tail latencies for low-volume tenants that nonetheless incur heavy prewarming.
- Need a simple per-tenant config surface to express: prewarm intensity, smoothing (token budget smoothing over time), and a safe sandbox endpoint to simulate cost/latency impact.
- This is a personal sketch for API shape + runtime heuristics; aim to iterate with SRE + product.

Goals:
- Give tenants/operators knobs to: limit burst prewarm cost, smooth token consumption across windows, prefer light prewarm for interactive tenants, aggressive prewarm for batch-heavy ones.
- Keep default behavior conservative (auto-suggested profiles) so no config -> safe fallback.
- Provide sim endpoints and telemetry to validate effects before rollout.

Constraints / guardrails:
- Must never violate tenant-level hard token quota.
- Ensure warmup does not cause resource churn (rapid up/down scaling).
- Config should be quickly revocable (API to disable per-tenant warmup immediately).
- Ops should be able to opt-in to system recommendations.

API surface (sketch):
- GET /v1/tenants/{tid}/warmup-config  -- read config
- POST /v1/tenants/{tid}/warmup-config -- create/update config (idempotent)
  payload (example):
  {
    "mode": "auto|manual|off",
    "profile": "interactive|batch|steady",
    "prewarm": {
      "target_workers": 2,                // target number of warm runners to keep warm
      "max_prewarm_tokens_per_min": 2000, // cap spend per minute for prewarm work
      "burst_multiplier": 1.5             // allow short bursts above target_workers
    },
    "smoothing": {
      "window_sec": 300,                 // sliding window to smooth token consumption
      "alpha": 0.2,                      // exponential smoothing coeff (0..1)
      "min_effective_tokens": 20        // do not smooth below this threshold
    },
    "fallback_policy": "throttle|defer|fallback_model",
    "annotations": "string (human notes, ticket links)"
  }

- POST /v1/tenants/{tid}/warmup-simulate  -- run a simulator against historical traffic/sample to estimate cost/latency impact
  request body: { "range": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z/2026-02-01T00:00:00Z", "samples": 2000 }
  response: { "simulated_cost_delta": "+$12.50", "95th_latency_change_ms": "+13ms", "prewarm_hours": "32h" }

Runtime heuristics (notes, to be iterated):
- Auto mode: system computes base_prewarm based on recent QPS and session-churn. Use p95 sequence length and session-start rate.
- Smoothing: maintain EWMA of actual token spend per tenant (alpha param). When a sudden spike happens, allow smoothing to pull from "smoothing credit" pool up to a multiplier, otherwise throttle.
- Token-credit ledger: tenants accumulate smoothing credits when under budget (eg 0.5 * spare capacity), capped at 4x their per-window budget. Credits expire after 24h.
- Prewarm vs smoothing decision: prefer smoothing first for tenants with <10 RPS; prewarm workers only when sustained requests > 30s apart and cache priming observed.
- Backoff: exponential backoff for failed prewarm attempts (avoid storming under infra flaps).

Telemetry & instrumentation (what to expose):
- warmup.prewarm_worker_count (gauge)
- warmup.prewarm_spend_tokens (counter)
- warmup.smoothing_applied_rate (percentage)
- warmup.simulation_{id}.result (store for audit)
- per-tenant: smoothing.ewma_tokens, smoothing.credit_balance, warmup.disabled_by_admin (bool)
- Alerts: sudden prewarm spend > X% of tenant monthly commit -> PagerDuty to cost ops channel (configurable)

Example config YAML (for ops doc):
- tid: tenant-42
  mode: manual
  profile: interactive
  prewarm:
    target_workers: 1
    max_prewarm_tokens_per_min: 1500
    burst_multiplier: 1.2
  smoothing:
    window_sec: 600
    alpha: 0.25
    min_effective_tokens: 10
  fallback_policy: fallback_model
  annotations: "ticket RI-4321: trialing smoothing for mobile client bursts"

Safety & rollout plan (rough):
1) Implement read-only sim endpoint + config validation.
2) Roll out autopilot suggestions as "recommended" only (no enforcement).
3) Enable manual mode for small cohort (internal tenants + 5 customers). Monitor warmup.prewarm_spend_tokens and smoothing.credit_balance.
4) If no regressions after 2 weeks, enable auto mode opt-in for more tenants.
5) Default auto mode off for enterprise unless they opt-in.

Open questions / decisions to surface:
- Do we surface "smoothing credit" as billable metric? likely no; show only in telemetry.
- How to reconcile smoothing with Dedicated reserved capacity behavior? Dedicated customers should be able to disable smoothing (they pay for capacity).
- Should smoothing apply across tenant subprojects (multiple API keys)? probably treat at tenant-level by default; add opt-in for per-key granularity.
- UI: simple toggle + recommended profile in Console; plus advanced YAML editor for power users.

Quick TODOs (my personal list):
- [ ] Draft server-side config validation rules (min/maxs) and safety checks.
- [ ] Add sim endpoint prototype to runtime/sim (PR stub linked above).
- [ ] Sketch Console UI mock (toggle + single metric card).
- [ ] Run offline sim against last 30d of small-tenant traffic to gather baseline numbers.
- [ ] Sync with SRE on prewarm backoff semantics.

Notes to self:
- Keep API minimal first; we can add more knobs later (eg warmup priority classes).
- Document strong defaults: for interactive profile, alpha ~0.2, window 300s; for batch profile, alpha 0.6, window 1800s.
- Remember to prevent smoothing from masking abusive behavior; integrate with abuse detectors.
